name: Love under the night
source: Five years after graduation and a moved on crush, you meet him again during a class reunion. As you suddenly find yourself in another region ruled by his father with the task of organizing the grand opening of the Moontide festival, the feelings you thought discarded come back like a wave in your heart.
translation: 毕业五年后，一次心动的暗恋，你在一次同学聚会上再次见到了他。当你突然发现自己身在父亲统治的另一个地区，肩负着组织月潮节盛大开幕的任务时，你本以为已经抛弃的感情又像波浪一样涌上心头。
